name: Kashmir to Ladakh Explorer with Turtuk
description: Embark on a spectacular journey through the mesmerizing landscapes of Kashmir and Ladakh. This carefully designed itinerary blends scenic beauty, cultural richness, and high-altitude adventure including a rare visit to the culturally rich border village of Turtuk.
route: Srinagar → Sonmarg → Zoji La → Drass → Kargil → Lamayuru → Leh → Khardung La → Nubra Valley → Turtuk → Pangong Lake → Chang La → Leh
highlights: Shikara ride on the iconic Dal Lake
Visit to Mughal Gardens in Srinagar
Scenic drive through Zoji La Pass
Visit to ancient monasteries like Lamayuru, Hemis & Thiksey
Camel safari in Nubra Valley sand dunes
Excursion to Turtuk village near LOC
Visit to the stunning Pangong Lake

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Srinagar Airport. Visit Mughal Gardens such as Nishat Bagh and Shalimar Bagh. Evening Shikara ride on Dal Lake. Overnight stay in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Kargil
itinerary.desc: Drive towards Kargil via Sonmarg and Zoji La Pass. Visit Drass Village and War Memorial. Overnight in Kargil.

itinerary.title: Kargil to Leh
itinerary.desc: Visit Mulbekh Buddha statue, Lamayuru Monastery, Moonland, Indus-Zanskar Sangam, Magnetic Hill, Gurudwara Pathar Sahib. Evening Leh Market, Shanti Stupa and Leh Palace.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La
itinerary.desc: Drive to Nubra Valley via Khardung La Pass. Visit Diskit Monastery and Hunder Sand Dunes. Optional camel safari. Overnight in Nubra.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Turtuk (Day Excursion)
itinerary.desc: Visit Turtuk village near Indo-Pak border. Explore Balti traditions and scenic surroundings. Visit Thang village (LOC viewpoint). Return to Nubra.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Lake via Shyok
itinerary.desc: Drive to Pangong Lake via scenic Shyok route. Explore the changing colors of Pangong Lake. Overnight near the lake.

itinerary.title: Pangong to Leh via Chang La
itinerary.desc: Return to Leh via Chang La Pass. Visit Shey Palace and Thiksey Monastery. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Transfer to Leh Airport for departure with unforgettable memories.

inclusions: Accommodation in hotels/camps on double sharing basis
Private vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing
